rationale: Gold anaplastic thyroid ca was on the S3 list but rejected while S4 overfit to pyriform-fossa SCC anatomy.
HLH is the named hemophagocytic complication within gold KFD-plus-HLH and is an acceptable champion.
Lacrimal sac abscess is the localized abscess form of acute dacryocystitis, missing only the optic-nerve qualifier.
First branchial cleft anomaly is a closely related congenital otologic fistula differential acceptable for this presentation.
S4 overfit to the paraneoplastic skin finding and rejected urothelial carcinoma that was on the shortlist.
Disseminated tuberculosis is a more specific form of gold tuberculosis and should count as correct.
Amyloidosis was on S3 but wrongly rejected in favor of scurvy despite Congo-red–compatible disease.
NBCCS and MHIBCC are related hereditary multiple-BCC syndromes; NBCCS is an acceptable match here.
FIP1L1-PDGFRA CEL never entered the S3 shortlist, which was dominated by histiocytosis/mastocytosis.
ARVC is the standard name for arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy; biventricular involvement is a trivial qualifier.
Malignant melanoma of the caruncle is a synonym of caruncular melanoma.
Atopic dermatitis is the parent disease encompassing severe chronic atopic hand eczema.
Vagus-mediated AV block is not sick sinus syndrome; S4 misread Holter slowing as a sinus-node disease.
Rowell syndrome never made the S3 shortlist, which stayed in generic cutaneous-lupus labels.
Sarcomatoid SCC and spindle-cell SCC are the same entity, so the scored miss is a judge error.
Variant angina was on S3 but rejected while S4 overfit alcohol history to cardiomyopathy.
Keloidal scleroderma was absent from S3; only broader scleroderma/morphea labels appeared and were dropped.
Malakoplakia without the cutaneous site qualifier is the same disease as cutaneous malakoplakia.
S4 misattributed vitreous crystals to cystinosis and sidelined morning-glory/synchysis findings.
CARASIL is the homozygous HTRA1 extreme, not heterozygous HTRA1-CSVD, so the subtype label is wrong.
PMR was on S3 but rejected after S4 overfit MRI psoas edema to a made-up psoas myositis label.
Localized amyloidosis of the urethra is a spaced synonym of LocalizedUrethralAmyloidosis.
Champion matches gold trigeminal schwannoma exactly.
COVID-19 is only the parent infection and omits the gold ocular neuropathy/panuveitis diagnosis.
Sickle cell retinopathy is an acceptable parent label for PAMM occurring in sickle cell disease.
Intracerebral hemorrhage is the same hemorrhagic stroke entity; facial-paralysis detail is a qualifier only.
BRVO never entered S3, which was filled with AMD/CNV neovascular labels instead.
Candida meningitis was on S3 but rejected while S4 overfit to NMDAR antibody encephalitis.
IART without the variable-AV-block qualifier is still the same arrhythmia diagnosis.
Abdominal tuberculosis is absent from S3, which listed only malignancy/inflammatory mimics.
Coronary artery disease is the correct parent of three-vessel obstructive CAD.
Primary systemic amyloidosis is synonymous with primary systemic (AL) amyloidosis.
Hemangioma never reached S3 among cardiac-mass differentials dominated by myxoma.
Fascicular VT was missing from S3, which only listed SVT/AVNRT-family options.
HFLT never appeared on S3; Nora lesion is a different tumor wrongly crowned.
Posterior corneal dystrophy was not on S3; lattice dystrophy is a sibling mislabel.
Syringocystadenocarcinoma papilliferum was on S3 but rejected for benign hidradenoma papilliferum.
Fabry-related option was on S3 but S4 overfit autonomic/ataxia features to MSA instead of PAGD.
Amyopathic dermatomyositis correctly names the flare phenotype, omitting only the secukinumab trigger.
HLP never entered S3; lichenoid keratosis is a different lichenoid differential.
Cutaneous T-cell lymphoma is the correct parent category of CD8-positive granulomatous CTCL.
Pyoderma gangrenosum never reached S3, which only listed device-infection options.
Ischemic colitis was on S3 but rejected after S4 overfit skip lesions to Crohn disease.
Pemphigus erythematosus was absent from S3; SCLE is an overlapping but incorrect sibling.
PPP/IPMN never made S3; pancreatic adenocarcinoma is a related but wrong pancreatic label.
Biliary cystadenocarcinoma was not on S3; abscess was chosen over even the near cystadenoma option.
Rhabdomyolysis is only the pathophysiologic consequence, not dengue viral myositis itself.
Pustular psoriasis never entered S3 among AGEP/SCAR drug-reaction labels.
Acinic cell carcinoma of breast was missing from S3; IDC is a sibling breast-cancer default.
S4 overfit the umbilical metastasis pattern to colorectal primary instead of jejunal adenocarcinoma.
Juvenile ossifying fibroma was on S3 but rejected in favor of cherubism.
Intracranial fungal infection is an acceptable broader parent of cerebral mucormycosis.
Malignant myopericytoma never reached S3 among other vascular-tumor options.
Liposarcoma was on S3 but rejected after S4 overfit submucosal bleeding behavior to GIST.
Sporotrichosis was absent from S3, which listed only facial granulomatous dermatoses.
Wilms tumor was on S3 but rejected while S4 defaulted to adult RCC patterning.
Neurocysticercosis never entered S3 among IIH/arachnoid-cyst intracranial-pressure options.
LTBP2-related ocular syndrome is the gene-level name for juvenile glaucoma with LTBP2 variants.
Mediastinal abscess correctly captures the infected bronchogenic-cyst presentation as a parent phenotype.
Schwannoma never reached S3 among wrist soft-tissue mass differentials.
